channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: smartnumbers-hermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This Hermes plugin enables the reception, archiving, and analysis of Smartnumbers conversation transcripts. It automatically queues asynchronous post-call agent reviews and executes user-defined natural language callbacks using the Hermes cron system.

item.title: hermes-codex-skin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Codex Skin is a community plugin for Hermes Desktop that provides a Codex-inspired chat layout and typography while maintaining native application behavior. It includes a dedicated theme for original Codex color palettes and supports native Hermes features like Glass translucency and voice controls.

item.title: hermes-memoss (Developer Tools)
item.description: MemOS Memory Plugin for Hermes Agent connects to a self-hosted MemOS instance to provide persistent memory storage. It enables semantic search, fact extraction, and automatic synchronization of conversation turns.

item.title: hermes-hud (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a local-first, read-only dashboard plugin for the Hermes Agent that provides real-time monitoring of system health, token usage, and session activity. It operates as a user-level extension that integrates with the official dashboard via a shared snapshot cache and WebSocket event stream without modifying the core agent.

item.title: hermes-hud (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a terminal-based consciousness monitor and dashboard for Hermes AI agents. It reads data from the agent's local directory to display live information regarding memory, tool usage, project status, and error logs.

item.title: skill-evolution (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Skill Evolution is a Python-based framework for autonomous agent skill improvement that analyzes past sessions to generate structured proposals. It features an evaluation gate with multiple evaluators and host-agnostic adapters for Hermes and Claude Code.

item.title: cli (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: @sandbaseai/cli is a command-line tool and local bridge that uses the Model Context Protocol to connect AI agents to over 2,000 models and APIs. It enables agents to access web search, social media data, and real-time information through a single browser-based authorization.

item.title: hermes-ai-usage (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes AI Usage Monitor is a read-only extension for Hermes Agent that provides telemetry for provider quotas and local token usage. It supports the native Desktop app and Web Dashboard, displaying session history and consumption metrics without reading prompt or message content.

item.title: hermes-speech (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Speech is a plugin for Hermes Agent 0.20+ that integrates text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities via the AllModels API. It enables conversational setup, voice search, and streaming audio using Hermes' standard provider interfaces and bundled libraries.

item.title: hermes-live-voice (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Live Voice is a self-hosted realtime voice gateway and dashboard plugin for Hermes Agent that enables continuous voice interaction during background task execution. It manages task supervision, progress streaming, and client protocols while delegating speech processing to local or hosted realtime providers.

item.title: agent-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: agent-skills is a collection of production-tested markdown files that provide specific workflows and commands for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. These skills establish trust infrastructure through proportionate-review patterns, ranging from session state management to multi-agent code reviews.

item.title: agent-memory-kit (Memory & Context)
item.description: Agent-memory-kit is a file-based curation loop designed to manage agent memory by identifying contradictions and outdated information. It uses markdown files and JSON diffs to provide a human-reviewed "forgetting pass" without the use of databases or vector stores.

item.title: hermes-startup (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes Startup is a local-first skill for Hermes Agent designed to help users identify business ideas and prepare small-scale tests. The tool operates through a deterministic zero-network local runtime that uses a series of questions to generate evidence-labeled ideas based on user knowledge.

item.title: demo-gif-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This skill for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for README files. It analyzes a repository to generate recording scripts using vhs for terminal interfaces or Playwright for web applications, then renders and optimizes the output.

item.title: claude-context-os (Memory & Context)
item.description: Context OS is a Git-backed context and workflow layer designed to maintain durable project information, decisions, and workflows in Markdown format for coding agents. It uses a deterministic lifecycle kernel to manage session handoffs, state transitions, and reviewable memory proposals across multiple supported runtimes.

item.title: agent-skill-builder (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: agent-skill-builder is a tool for creating and validating Claude Code and portable Agent Skills. It uses a runtime-aware validator to check for structural drift, broken links, and unsafe command injections while maintaining spec-current frontmatter through weekly drift detection.

item.title: incontext (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: incontext is a Hermes Agent plugin that dynamically budgets output space against the active context boundary. It inserts an output cap when remaining space meets a configured reserve or caller-supplied limit, otherwise leaving the request unchanged to avoid truncated responses.

item.title: hermes-appearance-hub (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Appearance Hub is an integrated appearance management plugin for the Hermes desktop client delivered as a single ESM file. It centralizes settings for themes, fonts, paper textures, and window transparency into a status bar entry with persistent configuration.

item.title: hermes-agent (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint via a hosted MCP server. It includes five ready-to-use skills and is compatible with clients following the Agent Skills standard.

item.title: hermes-bounty-board (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This Python plugin for Hermes Agent enables users to answer customer support bounties for USDC or manage their own bounty boards. Payments are processed over HTTP using x402, requiring no accounts or API keys, with 85% of rewards paid to the submitting wallet upon human approval.

item.title: hermes-connector (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Connector is an open-source Chrome extension that enables a local Hermes Agent to read and control specific browser tabs. It embeds a local Hermes dashboard into the Chrome side panel, allowing users to manually attach tabs to exact Hermes profiles and sessions.

item.title: hermes-windows-runtime-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This community-maintained skill pack for Hermes Agent provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. It enables agents to identify execution domains and verify existing Python interpreters without installing new software or modifying project files.

item.title: Life_OS (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Life OS is a personal management system that uses an AI agent to design and maintain habits, tasks, and goals. The system runs locally on a machine using SQLite for data storage, requiring no account or cloud synchronization.

item.title: hermes-cybersec-lab (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes Cybersecurity Lab is a turnkey ecosystem designed for the Hermes Agent. It provides a collection of 2,077 skills, 131+ tools, and 28 cybersecurity frameworks across eight repositories.

item.title: skillseal (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: SkillSeal is a trust system for AI agent skills that uses verifiable evidence and cryptographic signatures to certify them. It employs an evaluator to test skills in isolated Docker containers and a certifying authority to sign the resulting evidence.

item.title: lock-on-absence (Domain Applications)
item.description: Lock on Absence is a Python-based tool that automatically locks a workstation when the user is no longer present. It uses webcam frames and various recognition backends to determine presence and manage workstation state.

item.title: hermes-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes Skills is an open-source collection of modular tools for the Hermes Agent ecosystem and other compatible platforms. The repository provides scripts for video transcription, AI text refinement, OCR document extraction, and e-commerce image generation.

item.title: Hermes-OTG (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: Hermes OTG is a portable, zero-install version of the Hermes Agent designed for Windows 10 and 11. It operates from any drive or folder using relative paths to avoid host system pollution and can run side-by-side with an installed Hermes instance using a separate port and data directory.

item.title: hermes-voice (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes-voice is a voice-enabled personal assistant designed for Hermes Agent. It operates entirely locally using speech recognition, voice activity detection, wake word detection, and speech synthesis.

item.title: progressive-skill (Guides & Docs)
item.description: Progressive Skill is a tool for managing agent skill indices through progressive disclosure, budget control, and usage-frequency learning. It reduces token overhead by demoting less relevant skill categories into compact single-line summaries while maintaining discoverability.
